description: This file defines the NotesAdapter class for an Android application, which adapts a list of Note objects for display in a RecyclerView. It manages view binding and handles item clicks.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying a list of notes with click handling.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.NoteViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to note item views.

methods.name: updateNotes
methods.description: Updates the internal list of notes and refreshes the RecyclerView display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data from a Note object to the ViewHolder views and sets click listener.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of notes in the list.
